bio.text: Tina Kotek, a Democrat, has been Governor of Oregon since January 9, 2023, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary.
She served in the Oregon House of Representatives from 2007 to 2022, including as House Speaker from 2013 to 2022.
Before holding office she worked as a policy director at Children First for Oregon and in advocacy at the Oregon Food Bank.

According to the governor's office, she moved to Oregon in 1987 and graduated from the University of Oregon; Ballotpedia lists a master's degree in international studies from the University of Washington.
